spans.s: केदारः [kēdārḥ], 1 A field under water; meadow; केदारेभ्यस्त्व- पो$गृह्णन्कर्षका दृढसेतुभिः
; cf. the play on words in the Subhās. के दारपोषणरताः ? and the reply is केदारपोषणरताः.
A basin for water round the root of a tree.
A particular mountain forming part of the Himālayas (modern Kedār).
N. of a Rāga (in music).-Comp. -खण्डम् a small dyke, earth raised to keep out water; गच्छ केदारखण्डं बधान
